richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bhagalpur

c: Bhagalpur sits on the south bank of the Ganga in eastern Bihar and is known across India for its tussar silk. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bhagalpur for university and college grounds, schools, municipal parks, riverside walking areas and housing colonies. Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,590 km away, and sent to Bhagalpur by road.

Summers in this part of Bihar are hot and sticky, and the monsoon brings heavy rain from June onwards. That decides two things for an open gym. People will use it mostly early in the morning and after sunset, so good lighting nearby matters as much as the machines. The equipment must also stay outdoors through months of humidity, which is why we build it on galvanised frames with roto-moulded parts in place of painted mild steel.

items.q: Can a college in Bhagalpur order an outdoor gym for its students?
items.a: Yes. Send us the size of the area and the number of students likely to use it at one time. We will suggest a mix of strength and cardio machines and mark each one on a layout drawing.

items.q: Do humid summers damage the machines?
items.a: The frames are galvanised and the seats and handles are roto-moulded plastic, so humidity does not rust or rot them. Wipe them down after the monsoon and check bolts every few months.

items.q: Who fixes a problem after installation?
items.a: Call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or write to aftersales@funplaysystems.com. Galvanised frames carry a 3-year warranty and bearings carry 1 year against manufacturing defects.
